items.title: Hollander POTD James Donaldson. Drafted 73rd by SEA from Washington St in 79. Played yr in Italy & then a solid big for SEA, LAC & DAL. Peaked at 11 ppg 12 rpg in 86-87. Not skilled but big & active. Made 88 all-star game. Dawkins dubbed him "American Tourister" for huge noggin.
items.author: HoopsAnalyst
